address: Al Basateen Mall. Prince Mohammed Bin Abdulaziz Road, Al Rawdah, Jeddah, 23431, Saudi Arabia
bio: Journey to Japan at this restaurant in the heart of Jeddah's city centre. The spacious eatery boasts a modern Japanese style with various seating options – sit at the counter to watch the sushi chefs in action or pick a table in the main hall or on the patio area. As for the menu, you can expect a wide selection of classics and modern interpretations – you’ll find popcorn shrimps from the tempura section, fine Wagyu kushi grilled skewers from the robata section and freshly prepared nigiri at the sushi section. Four dishes per person should suffice, with the chicken gyozas being a must-try!
